feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.heading: How did it go?
feedback.private: Only Grouper sees your answers. Nobody is told what you said.
feedback.explainer: Everyone is ticked; untick anyone who wasn't there. It only counts as a no-show if most of you do. Meet again: if you both say yes, you can be matched again after 4 weeks. If either of you says no, never again. Not sure? Leave it blank.
feedback.notThereMyselfBody: Then you can skip who came and who to meet again. Just tell us about the pod below.
feedback.keepBody: If at least 3 of you choose Keep, the pod plans its next meetup with just those people.

member.title: Member
member.blockActive: You'll never be matched again. {{name}} is taken out of this pod and only sees that the pod changed.
member.blockBody: You'll never be matched again, and photos are hidden both ways.
member.reportBody: {{name}} won't know who reported. Reports can pause someone from matching.
member.reportBodyUnknown: They won't know who reported. Reports can pause someone from matching.
member.leaveNote: Want to leave instead? You can leave the pod from its menu at any time. The others only see “A member left”.
member.whatHappens: What should happen to the pod?
member.choiceRemoveHint: The others only see that the pod changed.
member.leaveHint: {{name}} stays in the pod. The others only see “A member left”.
member.replan: Take them out and re-plan the meetup
member.replanExplainer: They already know where and when you're meeting. Re-planning picks a new time and place within 48 hours.

report.title: Report
report.messageCopy: We keep a copy of this message with your report for 12 months, also after the chat is deleted.
report.question: What happened?
report.textWarningName: Please don't include health or other sensitive details. {{name}} will not know who reported.
report.textWarning: Please don't include health or other sensitive details. Nobody is told who reported.
